name: Fairmont The Norfolk
positioning: Historic city hotel in Nairobi with tropical gardens, a vintage transportation collection and rooms called 1937 Rooms
best_for: Travelers who want a garden-setting base in Nairobi

facts.text: The hotel sits along Harry Thuku Road in Nairobi, about 10 minutes from the airport.
The hotel is surrounded by tropical gardens.
The hotel offers a Fairmont Gold experience.
The Fairmont Family Room has two interconnecting spaces, with a queen bed, two single beds and a rain shower.
The hotel has a spa and a gym.
The hotel offers guided city tours of Nairobi's history.
The hotel has venues for meetings and conferences.

highlights.text: Some suites are called 1937 Rooms and are presented as a tribute to the hotel's past.
Deluxe Courtyard Rooms have views of the garden, with exotic birds, flowers and the hotel's vintage transportation collection.
Deluxe Verandah Rooms each have a private verandah with part views of the gardens.
The hotel is surrounded by tropical gardens.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the city-centre setting means guests seeking a remote or nature-immersive retreat may prefer a lodge outside the city.
WhataHotel notes that as a historic property, some room layouts may feel more traditional than ultramodern.
